title: Spring for Sophie
author: Yael Werber

hero.name: Sophie
hero.description: Young girl (child protagonist) eagerly waiting for and discovering spring — Sophie is a generic child character so a Boardmaker girl image may suffice, but she has a distinctive illustrated style
hero.source_note: Sophie is a generic child character — a Boardmaker 'girl' icon is acceptable; if the classroom edition uses her specific illustrated likeness, source from publisher or TPT

notes: Several fringe words (robin, bud, rain, sun, mud, worm, flower) already exist in activity_images or aac_extras — these can be reused directly. 'Spring' is the central concept and most important fringe word; a seasonal image (flowers, sunshine, green landscape) works best. 'Wait' is a key emotional/action word as Sophie waits impatiently for spring to arrive — it is picturable (child waiting) and highly communicative for this book. 'Grow' and 'butterfly' round out the transformation/nature theme central to the story. Colour words (green, yellow) were considered but 'colour' is already in core row 5, so they were not prioritised over concrete nouns.
